sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Second Amendment Act 2009
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 2009
ACT II OF 2009
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE
MINISTERS
(SALARIES, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES)
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2009
An Act further to amend
the North-West
Frontier Province Ministers (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.
Extraordinary,
30th January, 2009]
No.PA/NWFP-Bills/2009/3464, dated
30-1-2009.---The North-West Frontier Province Minister
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Second Amendment) Bill, 2009 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on 19th
January, 2009 and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier
Province on 24th January, 2009 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Legislature of the North-West Frontier Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the North-West Frontier Province Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975 (N.-W.F.P. Act No.IV of 1975)
for the purpose hereinafter appearing:
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the North-West Frontier Province Ministers (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) (Second Amendment) Act, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
